items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: Professor Arceola Blanchard. Is he still living? Yes sir he is. He's still teaching up at 35.

ctx.x: I remember once you told me Mr. Blanchard, did you call him Professor of the Pianist?
Professor Arceola Blanchard. Is he still living? Yes sir he is. He's still teaching up at 35. Up at 35. That's on Gerard and Ramport. Oh yeah.
We tried to see him then.
